title: 碎牛肉涨25%：烧烤季消费者抵触，谁在买单？
speaker: Alina Peng

segments.en: the price is just keep going up Alina I was looking at this it's not just the prime ribeye that you know you want to put on the grill later today ground beef up 25% since the beginning of 2025 beef prices overall up 12% year over year should we expect them to go higher
segments.zh: 价格一直在涨。Alina，我注意到不只是肋眼牛排，碎牛肉自2025年初以来上涨了25%，牛肉价格整体同比上涨12%。我们该预期继续上涨吗？

segments.en: it's really hard to say I think right now we are sort of in like what is described as like the peak of grilling season which runs from like Memorial Day to Labor Day so this tends to be a very strong period for seasonal demand
segments.zh: 很难说。现在正处于烧烤季高峰期，从阵亡将士纪念日到劳动节，这通常是季节性需求很强的时期。

segments.en: but some of the early data that we've seen coming out from July 4th has actually revealed a little bit more pushback from consumers and the industry expected not that consumers aren't buying beef but it seems like this may be the highest price point they're willing to pay
segments.zh: 但7月4日的一些早期数据显示，消费者的抵触情绪比行业预期更强。不是说消费者不买牛肉，而是这可能是他们愿意支付的最高价格点。

segments.en: that being said even if demand like flat lines a little supply still remains fundamentally tight the latest data we saw from the USDA really still shows the cattle herd very close to the it's near five day five decade low
segments.zh: 话虽如此，即使需求持平，供应仍然根本性紧张。美国农业部最新数据显示，牛群规模接近五十年低点。

segments.en: and the process of rebuilding takes several years and also actually requires supplies to be a little bit tighter before they get better so I don't think we'll see a significant drop in in prices soon
segments.zh: 重建牛群需要数年时间，而且实际上需要供应先更紧张才能好转。所以我认为短期内价格不会大幅下跌。
